## What does this change do

## Why it's needed

What gap does this fill, or what did it fix?

## Type of change

- [ ] Correction (outdated command, wrong path, broken link, factual error)
- [ ] New script
- [ ] New playbook
- [ ] Improvement to existing content
- [ ] New/updated template
- [ ] Documentation only

## Testing (required for scripts)

- OS / version tested on:
- PowerShell / Bash version:
- Ran with standard (non-admin) user: yes / no

## Checklist

- [ ] Follows the placement guide in `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] Script has a header block (purpose, run-as requirement, example usage) if applicable
- [ ] No admin/root required for core functionality (or clearly noted if it improves output)
- [ ] No data transmitted off the local machine
- [ ] Internal links checked (relative paths resolve)
- [ ] Related issue linked, if one exists
